See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the repository workflow. Propose changes on a branch, preserve metadata, write in your own words, cite the evidence or source basis, and request review when a change could affect a lab requirement.

::: {.callout-warning}
Until governance is finalized, a pull request can improve draft text but cannot by itself turn it into an approved lab requirement.
:::
